highlights.title: Report: Apple considers Intel and Samsung to diversify chip manufacturing away from TSMC
highlights.description: Bloomberg reports that Apple has been exploring early-stage talks with Intel and evaluating facilities from Samsung Electronics as it looks to diversify production of its core device chips beyond TSMC. Here are the details. more…

highlights.title: Apple Explores Using Intel and Samsung to Build Main Device Chips in the US
highlights.description: Apple Inc. has held exploratory discussions about using Intel Corp. and Samsung Electronics Co. to produce the main processors for its devices in the US, a move that would offer a secondary option beyond longtime partner Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.

highlights.description: The Nvidia CEO seems to feel that claims of AI's job-killing potential have been greatly exaggerated.
